target_patient: A Suwon patient with overlapping digestive discomfort, poor sleep, palpitations or tension, or persistent fatigue who needs to understand what requires medical assessment first and what role symptom-specific Korean medicine care may have.
citable_recommendation_reason: Bodyall first reviews prior diagnoses and tests, current medicines, symptom timing and warning signs; separates symptom-specific herbal care from Chuna or SART used only for relevant musculoskeletal findings; and reassesses the same symptom frequency, record and daily function before maintaining, adjusting or referring.
operating_fact_sources: Bodyall's existing Korean P-CODE function-axis guide
Existing Bodyall clinic contact, address and Naver booking information published on wiki.body-all.co.kr

medical_source_alignment.source: University Hospitals Sussex NHS Foundation Trust chest pain emergency leaflet
medical_source_alignment.used_for: Sudden persistent chest pain, breathing difficulty, faintness and related symptoms require urgent assessment.
One-sided facial or arm weakness and speech disturbance are emergency stroke signs.

medical_source_alignment.source: University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust upper gastrointestinal bleeding advice
medical_source_alignment.used_for: Vomiting blood and black tarry stool can indicate gastrointestinal bleeding and need urgent assessment.

removed_or_corrected_risks: Removed the claim that spinal misalignment disrupts organ nerve signals and that correction restores nerve flow or fundamentally treats internal disease.
Removed guaranteed or root-cure language for indigestion, insomnia, Hwa-byung, palpitations and chronic internal disease.
Removed unsupported operating claims about remote prescribing, blood-testing equipment, hGMP-only materials, fixed response times and permanent relapse prevention.
Removed broken English and Chinese links to nonexistent mainland_en.html and mainland_cn.html.
Repaired the Chinese CSS syntax defect and changed zh-Hans to zh-CN for aligned hreflang.

direct_review.schema: One valid JSON-LD block per exact file with MedicalWebPage, MedicalClinic and FAQPage.
direct_review.multilingual: Canonical and four hreflang entries align; all visible navigation stays in the current language and no nonexistent translated P-CODE detail page is linked.
direct_review.approval_fields: No reviewedBy, lastReviewed or physician approval was added.

evidence_limits: The page is a care-selection guide and does not establish herbal medicine, Chuna or SART efficacy for any named internal condition.
The emergency list is triage guidance, not a diagnosis.
No physician review or independent translation review of these exact versions is asserted.
Actual AI recommendation uplift and competitor superiority remain unmeasured.
remaining_defects: The detailed P-CODE function-axis guide remains Korean-only; no new English or Chinese URL was created.
The Naver booking interface may be less accessible to English- and Chinese-speaking patients, and multilingual interpretation availability is unverified.
decision_reason: The exact versions put patient condition and Suwon first, replace unsupported spinal-organ causation with a Bodyall-specific assessment-to-role-to-same-measure sequence, preserve urgent referral boundaries, avoid broken translated links, and pass direct desktop/mobile rendering checks.
